scripts.build: npm run _wgsl && npm run _tsgo && vite build
scripts.start: npm run _wgsl && npm run _tsgo && concurrently --killothers --names tsgo,vite 'npm run _tsgo:watch' 'npm run _vite'
scripts.test:watch: npm run test:_init && concurrently --killothers --names tsgo,vite 'npm run _tsgo:watch' 'npm run _vitest:watch'
scripts.test:_init: rm -rf js && npm run _wgsl && npm run _tsgo
scripts._vitest: if test -z "$npm_config_file" ; then vitest --run js/spec ; else vitest --run "$npm_config_file" ; fi
scripts._vitest:watch: if test -z "$npm_config_file" ; then vitest --clearScreen false --watch js/spec ; else vitest --clearScreen false --watch "$npm_config_file" ; fi
